_note: 學習路徑內容建置第18批 #2／6：間接問句（wh- 疑問詞）語序（eng.t_mid.nouncl.indirect-wh，會考級／中階）。間接問句把 wh- 問句放進另一句裡（Do you know…, I wonder…, Can you tell me… 後面），用『直述句語序』：wh- 詞後接『主詞＋動詞』、不倒裝、不用助動詞 do/does/did。誘答以『倒裝 is the…／保留助動詞 does/did／主詞動詞一致漏掉／語序錯』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix iqw_）。

units.title_zh: 間接問句（wh- 疑問詞）語序
units.can_do: 我能把 wh- 直接問句改成間接問句（放進 Do you know…／I wonder… 後面），用直述句語序：wh- 詞後接主詞＋動詞、不倒裝、不用 do/does/did。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In an indirect (embedded) wh-question, use statement word order (subject + verb), with no inversion: 'Can you tell me where the station is?' (not 'where is the station').
claims.verification_ref: 間接問句用直述語序 subject + verb、不倒裝；where the station is（非 where is the station）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Do not use the auxiliary do/does/did in an indirect wh-question: 'I don't know what she wants' (not 'what does she want').
claims.verification_ref: 間接問句不用助動詞 do/does/did；what she wants（非 what does she want）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The wh- word stays at the front of the embedded clause, followed by the subject and verb: 'I wonder why he left early.'
claims.verification_ref: wh- 詞放子句最前面、後接主詞＋動詞；I wonder why he left；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Indirect questions often follow phrases such as 'Do you know ...', 'Can you tell me ...', 'I wonder ...', 'I'm not sure ...'.
claims.verification_ref: 間接問句常接在 Do you know…／Can you tell me…／I wonder…／I'm not sure… 之後；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 間接問句是把一個問句放進另一句裡（常接在 Do you know…, I wonder…, Can you tell me… 後面）。這時要用『直述句語序』：主詞在動詞前面、不倒裝。Do you know where the station is?（你知道車站在哪裡嗎？）注意是 the station is，不是 is the station。
Do you know where the station is?　（你知道車站在哪裡嗎？用 where the station is、不倒裝。）
間接問句裡不用助動詞 do/does/did。直接問句 What does she want? 改成間接要說 I don't know what she wants.（我不知道她想要什麼。）does 不見了，動詞回到一般形式 wants。
I don't know what she wants.　（我不知道她想要什麼。沒有 does，動詞用 wants。）
wh- 疑問詞仍放在子句最前面，後面接『主詞＋動詞』。Can you tell me when the movie starts?（可以告訴我電影幾點開始嗎？）when 後面是 the movie starts。
Can you tell me when the movie starts?　（可以告訴我電影幾點開始嗎？when + the movie starts。）

practice.stem: 選正確：Can you tell me where ____?（可以告訴我銀行在哪裡嗎）
options: the bank is
is the bank
does the bank
the bank does be

distractor_rationales.is the bank: 間接問句用直述語序 the bank is，不倒裝成 is the bank。
distractor_rationales.does the bank: 間接問句不用助動詞 does，而且句子也不完整。
distractor_rationales.the bank does be: 沒有 does be 這種說法，應該是 the bank is。

practice.feedback: 間接問句用直述語序：Can you tell me where the bank is?

practice.stem: 把 'What time does the show start?' 改成間接問句：Do you know ____?
options: what time the show starts
what time does the show start
what time the show start
what time does the show starts

distractor_rationales.what time does the show start: 間接問句不用 does，要用直述語序 the show starts。
distractor_rationales.what time the show start: 主詞 the show 是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 s：starts。
distractor_rationales.what time does the show starts: 多了助動詞 does、動詞又加了 s，兩個地方都錯。

practice.feedback: Do you know what time the show starts?：不用 does、用 starts。

practice.stem: 下面哪一句的間接問句是對的？
practice.answer: I wonder why he is so quiet.
options: I wonder why he is so quiet.
I wonder why is he so quiet.
I wonder why does he be so quiet.
I wonder why he does be quiet.

間接問句不倒裝，要用 why he is。
間接問句不用助動詞 does，而且 does be 不成立。
沒有 does be 用法，應該是 why he is quiet。

practice.feedback: I wonder why he is so quiet.：wh- 詞後接主詞＋動詞、不倒裝。

practice.stem: 選正確：I'm not sure ____ the keys.（我不確定她把鑰匙放在哪裡）
options: where she put
where did she put
where put she
where she did put

distractor_rationales.where did she put: 間接問句不用 did，要用直述語序 she put。
distractor_rationales.where put she: 語序錯了，主詞 she 要放在動詞前面：she put。
distractor_rationales.where she did put: 間接問句通常不用助動詞 did，直接用直述語序 she put。

practice.feedback: I'm not sure where she put the keys.：主詞在前、不用 did。

practice.answer: Could you tell me how I can get to the museum?
options: Could you tell me how I can get to the museum?
Could you tell me how can I get to the museum?
Could you tell me how do I get to the museum?
Could you tell me how get I to the museum?

distractor_rationales.Could you tell me how can I get to the m: 間接問句不倒裝，要用 how I can get。
distractor_rationales.Could you tell me how do I get to the mu: 間接問句不用助動詞 do，要用 how I can get／how I get。
distractor_rationales.Could you tell me how get I to the museu: 語序錯了，應該是 how I can get。

practice.feedback: Could you tell me how I can get to the museum?：直述語序、不倒裝。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Do you know where the bus stop is?
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：where the bus stop is（直述語序）、句尾問號有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。整句是問句時句尾可上揚，間接問句內部用直述語序平穩說。

lines.text: Can you tell me what this word means?
lines.intonation: 整句問句句尾可上揚、what this word means 用平穩直述語序

lines.text: I wonder when they will arrive.
lines.intonation: 陳述語氣、句尾 arrive 下收
